topic: The Mysterious Disappearance of the MV Joyita Crew (1955)
summary: In October 1955, the merchant vessel MV Joyita departed Samoa for the Tokelau Islands carrying 25 passengers and crew alongside valuable cargo. Five weeks later, the ship was discovered drifting 600 miles off course, waterlogged but buoyant due to its cork-lined hull, with all 25 people, life rafts, navigation gear, and cargo completely vanished.
research_points: The departure from Apia, Samoa on October 3, 1955, and the known mechanical issues with the vessel's starboard engine clutch.
The massive Royal New Zealand Air Force search operation covering over 100,000 square miles of the South Pacific.
The discovery on November 10, 1955, by the merchant ship Geraldine, revealing the vessel heavily listing, flooded, but physically unsinkable.
Onboard forensic evidence including a doctor's bag with bloody bandages, a radio set to the 2182 kHz emergency frequency with broken wiring, and stopped clocks.
The official 1956 New Zealand Commission of Inquiry findings, the leaky pipe failure hypothesis, and alternative theories regarding piracy or panicked evacuation.
title: Pasifik'in Ortasında Kaybolan 25 Ruh: MV Joyita Hayalet Gemisinin Sırrı
description: 3 Ekim 1955'te Samoa'dan yola çıkan MV Joyita, 25 yolcusu ve mürettebatıyla birlikte Pasifik Okyanusu'nda iz bırakmadan kayboldu. Beş hafta sonra sürüklenirken bulunan gemi su almıştı ancak mantar kaplı gövdesi sayesinde batmamıştı. Gemide ne tek bir insan ne de can salları vardı. Tıbbi çantalar, kanlı sargı bezleri ve arızalı bir telsiz... Batması imkansız olan bu gemide o gece ne yaşandı? Shadow Archive, denizcilik tarihinin en büyük gizemlerinden birini resmi arşiv belgeleriyle inceliyor.
